subject.title: feat(openrouter): forward OpenClaw session id as session_id

question: Should OpenClaw expose a permanent OpenRouter-plugin `forwardSessionId` opt-in that sends a stable derived session correlation value to OpenRouter, rather than requiring callers to set provider request parameters themselves?
rationale: The code can implement either path, but maintainers must choose the supported configuration boundary and accept the provider-facing identifier lifecycle/privacy contract.

options.title: Approve the plugin-scoped opt-in
options.body: Keep the default-off OpenRouter plugin setting, document the derived identifier and egress behavior, and require current-head live proof before merge.

options.title: Use an existing request-parameter surface
options.body: Avoid a dedicated plugin setting and require operators to control `session_id` through an existing supported OpenRouter request-parameter mechanism if that surface is intended for dynamic values.

options.title: Defer provider affinity support
options.body: Pause this feature until maintainers define a general session-affinity or provider-identifier policy that covers OpenRouter and similar providers.

recommendation.title: Approve the plugin-scoped opt-in
recommendation.body: Keep the default-off OpenRouter plugin setting, document the derived identifier and egress behavior, and require current-head live proof before merge.
